card.name: Subject classification code separators
card.fires_on: The separator (dash or > sign) or code digit right after a subject or classification code in academic repository records, such as JEL codes, FoR codes and Subjects lines, where a category title comes next.

modes.label: Dash after JEL code
modes.description: A hyphen following a JEL economics code letter or number, just before the category name.
modes.example: Find related papers by JEL classification: - I20<< ->> Health, Education, and Welfare - -

modes.label: Arrow after category heading
modes.description: A > sign after an uppercase category heading, leading into a narrower subcategory.

card.writes: It suggests category-like continuations such as category names and directory-style tokens.
card.plain: It marks the point in a library catalogue entry where a subject code is followed by its category title.
